Here are 5 bullet points on the #HMPV article:
 * Human metapneumovirus (HMPV) is a common respiratory virus that can cause cold-like symptoms.
 * In recent years, there has been an increase in HMPV cases in China. https://t.co/1Sn4f2lkMz

nodes.author: atulsinghji
nodes.text:
* The reasons for this increase are unclear, but may include increased spread of the virus or increased testing.
 * There is no vaccine for HMPV, but you can reduce your risk by washing your hands, avoiding sick people, and staying home when sick.

nodes.author: atulsinghji
